task.title: Claim cancelled in the new region — Overpayment (OP)

ul.li: Comments: Type “Change of address and active claims in 2 regions.”

Details: Detail the BPC to be retained, the BPC to be cancelled, the weeks that overlap the 2 BPCs and any other relevant information. Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-finding, Documentation and Retention Policy . National Fact-finding, Documentation and Retention Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, select the new region from the Mainframe tab.
Determine if a registration number is on file for the change of address issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 16.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 16.

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and input the disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 14 - Void benefit period .
Start date: Enter the start date for each disentitlement period.
End date: Enter the end date for each disentitlement period.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select D - Non-fraud - Duplicate payment .
Message: Select 21 - An overpayment resulted due to being paid twice for the same period .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the change of address issue.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select D - Non-fraud - Duplicate payment .
Message: Select 21 - An overpayment resulted due to being paid twice for the same period .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D — No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim that is converted to MPS.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 53 - Claim transfer .
Remarks line 1: Type “Change of address as of [insert date]. Active BPC in both regions.”
Remarks line 2: Type “D14 imposed on BPC in w/c [XXXX] in the new region to establish an OP for overlapping weeks paid.”
Remarks line 3: Type “Modify BPC in w/c [XXXX] to CS 8 for the new region and remove the weeks at issue from the pay history summary.”
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C — Yes to clear the registration number.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlement (2976)
D5, D12, D13, D14, D15 (3011)
D14 - Claim cancelled - Various reasons (3019)
BPC date - Sunday’s date (1060)
Select the Sunday of the week the D14 was imposed.
D14 - Text: Type “You have received payments to which you were not entitled as a result of having a duplicate claim in another region.”

step.cmd: In FTS, select the old region from the Mainframe tab.
Determine if there is a D48 or an MA48 on file:

ul.li: If there is an MA48 on file, go to step 23.
If there is no D48 or MA48 on file, go to step 25.
If there is a D48 on file, refer to Undeliverable mail . Then go to step 25. Undeliverable mail

step.cmd: In NWS, move the AI Transfer WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “MA48 on file awaiting adjudication.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 days.

step.cmd: When the AI Transfer WI moves to the current workload, determine if there is still an MA48 on file:

ul.li: If yes, repeat step 22.
If no, go to step 25.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the Address review field is highlighted on the Summary tab

ul.li: If yes, go to step 26.
If no, go to step 27.

step.cmd: Select the Name and Address Change/Transfer (M159) transaction and rescind the Address review field as follows:

ul.li: Address Review: Check the Rescind box.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Name and Address Change/Transfer (M159) transaction and input the change of SCC as follows:

ul.li:
New SCC: Select the appropriate SCC number:
If the file is transferred to the Atlantic region, select 1121 .
If the file is transferred to the Quebec region, select 2371 .
If the file is transferred to the Ontario region, select 3515 .
If the file is transferred to the Western Canada and territories region, select 4812 .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI.
